metadata.title: Auto-Post — draft, score, store pending, queue approved to Buffer
metadata.description: Second agent of Visa India Expert (visaindiaexpert.com). Invoked when the news-digest scenario (Step 7) finishes: it turns the daily briefing into 3 drafts (LinkedIn, X thread, blog intro), scores each 1–10, stores all three as rows with status=Pending in the Google Sheet 'Auto-Post Drafts', watches that sheet, and — only when a human sets a row's status to 'Approved' — queues it to Buffer at the next scheduled slot and sends a Gmail confirmation. HUMAN APPROVAL REQUIRED: nothing publishes until a human sets status=Approved in the sheet. Flow: Webhook (path 'auto-post-digest') → HTTP POST Anthropic (3 drafts + scores, JSON-only response) → Code (parse JSON, emit 3 rows) → Google Sheets AppendRow → Google Sheets WatchRows (status=Approved) → HTTP POST Buffer update/create → Gmail notification. SETUP CHECKLIST: (1) Buffer: connect LinkedIn, X and a blog channel in Buffer; create an app at Buffer → Settings → Apps to get the API key; add a Make credential named 'buffer' with field 'apiKey'; after connecting, record each channel_id (Buffer → channels) and put the three values into the Make credential/fields or the Buffer step's channel_id mapping (LinkedIn=…, X=…, Blog=…). (2) Create the Google Sheet 'Auto-Post Drafts' with columns date, platform, draft, score, status — see docs/agents/sheets-setup.md and docs/agents/sheets-template.csv. (3) Connect Google (Drive/Sheets) and Gmail in Make. (4) After import, re-pick the 'Append row' (gdrive:AppendRow) and 'Watch rows' (gdrive:WatchRows) actions on the 'Auto-Post Drafts' sheet if the import shows them broken — best-effort module ids. (5) Wire the trigger: at the end of the news-digest scenario add an HTTP POST step targeting this scenario's webhook URL (https://hook.<region>.make.com/<path>), body {"digestText": "<full briefing text>"} — or use Make's 'Execute a scenario' action instead of an HTTP call. (6) Buffer schedule (CET): LinkedIn 08:00 Tue/Thu/Fri; X 08:00/12:00/17:00 (Mon–Fri); Blog Friday 08:00 — extend the Code step (or add a small mapping) to compute schedule_at as the next slot matching the row's platform. (7) Test with a manual webhook call (see docs/agents/news-digest-test.md) before leaving it unattended.

flow.name: Webhook — auto-post-digest
flow.description: Triggered when the news-digest scenario finishes. HOW TO WIRE: add an HTTP POST step at the end of the news-digest scenario targeting this webhook's URL (https://hook.<region>.make.com/<scenario-path>/auto-post-digest) with a JSON body {"digestText": "<the full briefing text>"}; alternatively use Make's 'Execute a scenario' action pointing at this scenario. {{digestText}} below is read from the webhook payload field 'digestText'.

expectedPayload.digestText: Full text of the daily news briefing produced by the news-digest scenario

flow.name: HTTP — Anthropic: 3 drafts + scores (JSON only)
flow.description: POST to the Anthropic Messages API with the same endpoint/headers as the news-digest scenario (Make credential 'anthropic', field xApiKey). NOTE: update the model id (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) to the current Claude model before the first run. {{digestText}} is the webhook payload field. The model must reply with ONLY valid JSON; the next Code step extracts the first {...} block tolerantly.

flow.name: Code — parse response into 3 draft rows
flow.description:
JavaScript Code module. Input: the Anthropic HTTP response (map content.0.text to 'anthropic'). Extracts the first JSON object from the model text (tolerant of stray prose), then emits 3 rows: {date, platform:'LinkedIn', draft, score, status:'Pending'}, {date, platform:'X', draft (tweets joined with '

— '), score, status:'Pending'}, {date, platform:'Blog', draft (seoTitle + '

' + intro), score, status:'Pending'}. Returning an array of objects makes Make emit one row per object.

flow.name: Google Sheets — append 3 rows (Pending)
flow.description: Appends the 3 rows to the 'Auto-Post Drafts' sheet, columns: date, platform, draft, score, status. NOTE: if import shows this module broken, re-pick the Google Sheets 'Append row' action on the 'Auto-Post Drafts' sheet and map the row fields date/platform/draft/score/status from the Code step output. Each code row becomes one appended row (iterate over rows).

flow.name: Google Sheets — watch for status=Approved
flow.description: Watches the 'Auto-Post Drafts' sheet and passes through rows whose status column changes to 'Approved' (filter on the status column; value 'Approved', exact match). Runs on the scenario's watch interval (default ~15 min), so approved drafts are queued within ~15 minutes. NOTE: if import shows this module broken, re-pick 'Watch rows' on the 'Auto-Post Drafts' sheet with the same status filter.

flow.name: HTTP — Buffer: queue approved update
flow.description: Queues the approved draft to Buffer. SCHEDULE (CET): LinkedIn — 08:00 on Tue/Thu/Fri; X — 08:00, 12:00, 17:00 (Mon–Fri); Blog — Friday 08:00. The Code step (or a small mapping step before this one) must compute 'schedule_at' as the NEXT slot matching the row's platform (e.g. a LinkedIn row approved Wednesday queues for Thursday 08:00 CET; an X row approved Tuesday 14:00 CET queues for Wednesday 08:00 CET). 'channel_id' is the Buffer channel id for the row's platform: fill the platform→channel_id mapping (LinkedIn=…, X=…, Blog=…) into the Make credential/fields after the Buffer channels are connected. {{draft}} and {{score}} come from the watched row.

flow.name: Gmail — confirm queued to Buffer
flow.description: Sends the operator a confirmation that a draft was queued. Sends from the Make-connected Gmail account to info@visaindiaexpert.com. {{platform}} and {{score}} come from the watched row.

mappings.body: Draft for {{platform}} (score {{score}}, date {{#date}}) has been queued to Buffer at the next scheduled slot for that platform. Verify it in Buffer → scheduled posts.
